name: Temple Glen
source:
It's only the second day after it happened. Ryan drags himself off to school reluctantly, angrily... only to run into friends he's in no mood to deal with. What will happen to their friendships and the band they all formed?

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130110222911/http://bishojo.tk/gameshow.php?id=33]official website[/url]]
translation:
事情发生后才第二天。Ryan不情不愿、满怀怒气地拖着脚步去学校…偏偏又遇见了自己根本没心情应付的朋友们。他们之间的友谊，以及众人共同组建的乐队，将会发生什么？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130110222911/http://bishojo.tk/gameshow.php?id=33]官方网站[/url]]
